checks.check: Read root AGENTS.md, mandatory startup documents and m02-m03-code-v2 acceptance contract
checks.result: complete; source-review scope and unrun/native execution distinction preserved

checks.evidence: App/MetalStudyRenderer.swift validate iterates StudyValidationFixtures.all at width 48, requires non-nil StudyParityMetrics with passes == true before state becomes metal. Fixture source enumerates hard, soft, warm-rotated, dark, near-field, translated.

StudyParityMetrics requires matching dimensions, valid opaque RGBA, internally valid masks, equal unsupported counts and exact mask positions; passes requires mean channel error <= 1 and fractionAboveFour <= 0.005.

checks.check: Unavailable device, initialization and initial parity failures
checks.evidence: App/MetalStudyRenderer.swift lines 195-209 catches non-cancellation validation failures and selects CPU; production frame is rendered by ReferenceStudyRenderer after downgrade.

MetalStudyRenderer.supports forwards to StudyFloat32Eligibility; engine lines 212-229 bypasses Metal for unsupported scenes without changing validated Metal state. Bust rendering is CPU-only before backend initialization.
Engine lines 217-224 downgrade on invalidComputeOutput or non-StudyError backend failures. Other StudyError input failures propagate without disabling a working backend.

selectCPU at lines 232-236 first sets cpu state and calls frameCache.removeAll where backend == metal. StudyFrameCache.removeAll removes matching entries in reverse index order using the same cost-accounting removal; surviving CPU entries retain order. Engine render has no await suspension during state mutation/eviction.

StudyRendererTests covers all six raw Metal fixtures at width 96, engine/reference parity, CPU mannequin, CPU far geometry and near-field routing followed by normal-scene Metal output. Native GPU tests explicitly XCTSkip when no Metal device exists.

conclusion: No concrete must-fix correctness defect identified in the assigned backend validation/fallback/downgrade scope. Source control flow implements fail-closed CPU selection and removes cached Metal output on downgrade.
limitations: Host execution was unavailable: no agent_cycle.py check/next, Swift builds/tests, simulator runs, Metal execution, timings or visual review were performed.
Review used actual GitHub source pinned to base_sha; live branch status, uncommitted files, CI and historical execution claims were not independently verified.

Assigned native test file does not directly inject initial parity failure, device unavailability, or a runtime Metal fault after cached Metal success. Those branches and downgrade eviction were reviewed statically, not demonstrated by executed regression evidence.

The near-field test reuses the original normal-scene cache key for its final Metal assertion; a separate uncached normal scene would strengthen direct evidence of retained backend state. Current source correctly avoids a downgrade for near-field routing.
Buffer/dispatch internals, separate cache-key correctness and cancellation behavior were outside this review scope.
mutations: Unreferenced JSON report blob only; no source/tree/commit/ref mutation.
